expectations.text: The agent uses desloppify (not just generic lint/review) to scan
expectations.evidence: Agent attempted to install desloppify (5 attempts blocked by sandbox) but ultimately fell back to generic manual analysis. Did not follow desloppify's specific methodology or scoring framework — used its own 4/10 scale instead.

expectations.text: A Python venv is created for desloppify
desloppify scan is run against the codebase
The agent communicates findings to the user in plain language
expectations.evidence: Agent reported 'Health Score: 4/10' with 3 clearly described top issues and a detailed health-check-report.md with 7 findings and severity ratings.

expectations.text: The agent suggests concrete next steps for fixing issues
expectations.evidence: Top 3 fixes clearly described: (1) Delete or label DOCUMENTATION_SUMMARY.txt, (2) Fix broken justfile dev recipe, (3) Begin implementation. Priority order provided.

claims.evidence: Custom scoring not based on any standard framework. Reasonable subjective assessment but not comparable to desloppify scores.

eval_feedback.overall: Baseline produced solid manual analysis but used generic approach rather than desloppify framework. Good differentiation from with-skill.
